title: Find $$t$$
text: The point $$(1,1)$$ corresponds to $$t=0$$, since $$e^0=1$$ and $$\left(0-1\right)^2=1$$.

title: Find the slope and line
text: $$\frac{dx}{dt}=e^t=1$$ and $$\frac{dy}{dt}=2\left(t-1\right)=-2$$ at $$t=0$$, so $$\frac{dy}{dx}=-2$$. Then $$y-1=-2\left(x-1\right)$$, which simplifies to $$y=-2x+3$$.
